{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABYxznRg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhCXLh0", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 21, "title": "Re-test six period PC-98 DOS games after compatibility fixes and triage remaining failures", "body": "## Problem

[Issue #13](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/13) executed six independent period PC-98 DOS games against an earlier PC-9821Ap emulator build and found **zero confirmed playable**. It isolated three independent startup blockers, now fixed and merged:

- [#14](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/14) / [PR #19](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/19): BIOS INT 1Ch/AH=02h one-shot interval callbacks used by the NL driver.
- [#15](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/15) / [PR #18](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/18): clock-driven GDC horizontal-blank status used by MARKADIA.
- [#16](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/16) / [PR #20](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/pull/20): BIOS INT 18h/AH=1Ah user-defined characters used by PIPOO.

Those fixes passed original, redistributable guest regression tests, but **the actual six games were not rerun after the fixes**. Their real startup/gameplay compatibility is unknown, and TRIANS98's repeated reboot remains unexplained.

This Issue is **research, compatibility re-testing and targeted problem triage**, not an instruction to implement every missing feature or to declare these games playable merely because isolated probes pass.

## Expected outcome

On the **latest available `main`**, the implementer lawfully reacquires (or uses already lawfully obtained local copies of) the six games, runs them in the original Rust emulator **locally outside Git management**, compares behavior with the earlier baseline, and establishes which prior blockers are cleared and where execution now stops. Exercise actual menus/gameplay, controls, graphics, sound and saving as far as possible; investigate remaining failures and open **new, separate English `task`-labeled Issues only for independently evidenced, actionable defects**.

Do not upload game images, binary assets, commercial/proprietary fonts, supplied GR-DOS components, screenshots or raw game dumps to the repository, GitHub Issues, PRs, GitHub Actions artifacts, CI or Pages.

### Explicit initial re-test matrix

Use the exact versions, lawful author download paths, archive hashes, preparation steps and prior bounded observations in [docs/compatibility-investigation-13.md](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/compatibility-investigation-13.md), and reference the original [Issue #13 research comment](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/issues/13#issuecomment-6309507515).

| Title / version | Previously observed failure | Retest goal |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Samurai Shoujoden 1.10 | Supplied NL TSR stuck awaiting INT 1Ch interval callback | Confirm guest callback/NL progresses with the original publisher GR-DOS boot environment; follow execution into game/title/input |
| Circuit Angel 1.01a | Same NL interval callback block | Check independently with its own untouched original publisher boot image and correct driver options |
| Dengeki Butouki TURBO 1.56a | Same NL interval callback block | Check independently with its original environment and identify any new stall after NL |
| MARKADIA 1.05 | Endless polling of GDC status port 0060h bit 6 | Confirm transition is observed by original game, then investigate further title/video/audio/key handling with supplied MDRV98 |
| PIPOO 1.00 | Unsupported BIOS INT 18h/AH=1Ah user font | Confirm actual guest-defined characters load and game progresses beyond the previous return address; test animation/input/save if reached |
| TRIANS98 1.02 | Repeated unexplained resets/boot loop | Reproduce and trace the reset cause, distinguish a legitimate guest reboot/installation problem from CPU/BIOS/device error, and file a bug only when supported |

All six are **previously tested candidates, not evidence of current success**. Game names/versions and archive hashes identify them; do not change the targeted versions silently. The first three share a driver root cause but must each be re-run. Correct configuration includes the supplied boot and sound drivers, writable media where expected and selected PC-9821Ap DOS profile. No Windows or host game emulation.

### License and data-handling requirements

- Review each publisher/author's **current original distribution terms** and honor them for local acquisition and testing; being labeled freeware does not imply redistribution rights. If an original source becomes inaccessible or local-use rights are unclear, record it as blocked/inconclusive instead of substituting an unofficial archive or seeking a manual exception.
- Download/unpack original software, supplied DOS/driver files and generate HDM/FDI conversions, test save files and raw execution traces **inside the implementer's private local development environment outside the Git worktree** (prefer an isolated directory outside the repo). If an ignored directory is absolutely necessary, verify `git check-ignore`; inspect `git status`, PR changed files, and the Pages publication allowlist to prove no restricted data leaves that area. Keep source URLs and SHA-256 identifiers, not actual bytes, in shared reports.
- No game-specific binaries or copyright-restricted material may be fetched by hosted CI or be made a mandatory PR acceptance fixture. When a hardware issue is demonstrated, create an original small MIT guest test or another explicitly redistributable reproduction based on hardware specifications. Avoid copying/disassembling substantial game code and never include copyrighted art/audio or game screenshots.
- Do not alter the original games to bypass failures, recognize title names in the emulator, replace game graphics/audio with browser code, or assert an unsupported hardware feature is the cause merely because a game fails.

### Investigation procedure

1. Inspect the current `main`, [current machine limits](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/ap-devices.md), [original compatibility report](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/compatibility-investigation-13.md), and the merged fixes #14–#16. Verify code/build/test baseline and note exact tested commit SHA/profile.
2. Acquire and check the six source archives legally; reproduce their original valid boot setup using the earlier report. Reconstruct local FDI-to-HDM payload conversion as documented (without modifying game sectors), and prepare legal FreeDOS media for MARKADIA, TRIANS98 and PIPOO; preserve accompanying original sound drivers, files and writable attributes.
3. Run the **real native headless Rust core**, with bounded CPU/device observation (CS:IP/opcodes, ROM/BIOS services, guest resets, PIC/PIT/GDC/status ports, disk I/O, VRAM/framebuffer hashes, FM/PCM state). Check the previously observed signatures and compare against old results in a before/after table.
4. For each program that progresses past initialization, exercise as much as is reproducible: title screen, menu, keyboard controls, at least one actual gameplay transition, sprites/artwork/palette, animation, music and saving/loading. Where native inspection cannot establish real user-visible behavior, optionally run the **same actual Rust/Wasm core** using a local browser with legal personal media; do not claim functionality that was not tested. Keep comparisons objective and distinguish code executing vs genuinely playable.
5. Analyze unknown stops and especially TRIANS98 reboot: log reset vector/guest stack/call provenance and OS/environment evidence, narrow to an emulator defect only when justified. Confirm regressions or genuine new missing BIOS/GDC/CPU/FDC/sound functions with an independent, copyright-cleared micro-test whenever possible.
6. For each **distinct verified defect**, check existing GitHub Issues before filing; create a separate English `task` Issue using the repository's [template](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/issue.md). Include tested version and public lawful source, profile, exact observed vs expected behavior, minimal evidence/diagnosis, an original or open-licensed pre-merge reproduction, and automated acceptance. Group multiple affected titles with the same root cause; never file one issue for each game mechanically. Unknown causes should be reported as inconclusive, not a speculative fix task.
7. Post an English results comment on **this Issue** with a six-title before/after matrix, the actual version/commit tested, observations for boot/gameplay/video/input/audio/save, rights/data-isolation confirmation, remaining inconclusive cases, and links to new defect Issues. If no new reproducible defect is found, say so explicitly and do not invent tickets. An optional small original Markdown research report/PR is acceptable but not necessary.

### Constraints and workflow

- Keep scope to PC-9801/PC-9821 **MS-DOS games**, not Windows.
- CPU and chip emulation remain **fully original Rust**, with no x86/PC-98 emulator or chip emulator libraries/copied source. This task does not call for broad feature implementation.
- Do not change existing license-cleared guest fixtures, automatic GitHub Pages publishing or mandatory CI behavior simply to perform exploratory tests. The published site must never contain these game files.
- Follow the repository's [development process](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md). English for Issue/PR content and comments. If this task only produces investigation results, **no code PR or merge is required**. Any future actual fixes use their own Issues/PRs and automated tests.

## Context and reproduction

The original investigation at baseline `c1aaafabb0a7` found three related NL sound-driver stalls, the MARKADIA GDC status wait, the PIPOO unsupported BIOS font call and TRIANS98's repeating reset. The three identified missing behaviors are now addressed by merged PRs #19, #18 and #20 with independent test guests. None of those PRs asserted that the period games became playable. Re-run on current code rather than assuming that prior findings still hold.

Previous details: [investigation and checksum matrix](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/docs/compatibility-investigation-13.md). Avoid confusing freely distributed game disk images with freely redistributable firmware ROMs.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

For this **research-only Issue**, the following are **AI-verifiable task completion criteria**; no PR/merge is mandatory:

- [ ] All six exact candidate versions are attempted locally on up-to-date `main` under their documented lawful configurations, **or** each blocked acquisition/license/setup is explicitly recorded. Do not fabricate passes or substitute copyrighted downloads.
- [ ] Post a clear before/after matrix distinguishing startup past the prior blocker, interactive gameplay, video/animation, audio, save/reload, and untested functionality. State `playable`, `partial`, `failed`, or `inconclusive` based on measured facts, with tested commit/profile and bounded timings.
- [ ] Diagnose observed remaining failures as far as feasible, and treat TRIANS98's reboot specifically as **unresolved until positively explained**. Never attribute a hang solely to a missing port or BIOS contract without sufficient evidence.
- [ ] Open only non-duplicate actionable new `task` Issues for **independently verified** emulator defects, specifying objective pre-merge reproduction and regression tests with original/redistributable code; classify unresolved environmental/software cases honestly.
- [ ] Post an English summary comment linking follow-up Issues (if any), listing tested titles and limitations, and confirming all original game/ROM/media/downloads/logs stayed **outside Git, hosted CI, Pages and Issue/PR attachments**.
- [ ] Preserve current Rust emulator source, baseline CI/tests and Pages deployment unless a narrowly justified documentation-only update is made. No Windows, human gameplay sign-off, owned hardware, manual approval or deployed-site confirmation is necessary.

No acceptance depends on post-merge Actions/Pages runs, manual testing by a person, or providing unlicensed game disks to reviewers.

## Optional validation

Try additional legal PC-98 DOS titles, test VM and Ap differences, compare to authors' manuals or a lawfully accessible reference setup, and check more gameplay scenes and timing. These are helpful but not required for closing this research task.

## Required post-merge verification

None. Investigation should finish with a grounded Issue comment and follow-up tickets, not wait for a merge-triggered deployment. If a future separate fix changes Pages and it fails after merge, open a different `task` Issue.
